records.character_source: Videl / Great Saiyaman 2 / Pan customizable partner
records.skill_description: A short-range barrage of punches and kicks ending in a launching strike; the final portion can be canceled into an Ultimate Attack.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference describes a ten-hit short-range barrage and knockback. The move's in-game description explicitly supports canceling into an Ultimate Attack before the final kick. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted beyond documented characteristics.
records.acquisition_notes: The independent instructor guide lists Justice Rush as the basic reward for Gohan & Videl Lesson 1. No Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement is associated with the canonical acquisition route.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Short-range barrage with a documented Ultimate-cancel window before the final kick; detailed matchup and frame behavior remains version-sensitive.
